claims: The best 72-hole score at the Masters is 268 (20-under-par).
Dustin Johnson set the best 72-hole score at the Masters in 2020.
Dustin Johnson's 2020 performance broke the previous 72-hole record of 270 (-18) at the Masters.
The previous 72-hole record of 270 (-18) at the Masters was jointly held by Tiger Woods (1997) and Jordan Spieth (2015).
The lowest single-round score in Masters tournament history is 63.
Nick Price achieved a 63 at the Masters in 1986.
Greg Norman achieved a 63 at the Masters in 1996.
The highest winning score at the Masters is 289 (+1).
Sam Snead achieved a winning score of 289 (+1) at the Masters in 1954.
Jack Burke Jr. achieved a winning score of 289 (+1) at the Masters in 1956.
Zach Johnson achieved a winning score of 289 (+1) at the Masters in 2007.
The best score by a rookie at the Masters is 273.
Sungjae Im achieved a score of 273 as a rookie at the Masters in 2020.
The largest margin of victory at the Masters is 12 strokes.
Tiger Woods won the Masters by a margin of 12 strokes in 1997.
The 2020 Masters tournament was played in November.
The 2020 Masters tournament played in November resulted in softer course conditions.
Softer course conditions contributed to the record-setting score at the 2020 Masters.
